The scenario-based analysis compares four scenarios through December 2045. The reference uses business-as-usual management, CESM2 climate, and SSP370. Each alternative changes one dimension relative to the reference.

| Scenario | Management | Climate model | Pathway | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Reference | BAU | CESM2 | SSP370 | Reference scenario |
| Management | NBS | CESM2 | SSP370 | Management comparison |
| Climate model | BAU | MPI-ESM1-2-HR | SSP370 | Climate-model sensitivity |
| Pathway | BAU | CESM2 | SSP585 | Emissions-pathway sensitivity |

: Scenarios used in the 2024–2045 analysis. {#tbl-scenarios}

## Soil-carbon context

| Measure | Annual crops | Woody perennial crops | Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Inventory: December 2023 stock | 113.22 | 87.93 | 201.15 |
| Inventory: January 2016 to December 2023 change | -18.66 | -18.50 | -37.16 |
| Reference scenario: January 2024 stock | 124.96 | 95.84 | 220.80 |
| Reference scenario: January 2024 to December 2045 change | -30.52 | -14.81 | -45.33 |

: Statewide soil-carbon stocks and changes, Tg C. The inventory and scenario values come from separate simulation periods and are shown as context rather than as a continuous time series. {#tbl-soc-context}

The negative reference-scenario change may include adjustment from a non-stable initial state. Scenario effects are therefore evaluated primarily as matched differences from the reference trajectory.

## Scenario effects relative to the reference

| Contrast | Annual crops | Woody perennial crops | Statewide mean | Statewide p05–p95 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Management minus reference | 0.73 | 0.83 | 1.55 | -1.81 to 3.86 |
| Climate model minus reference | 0.36 | -0.77 | -0.41 | -5.06 to 3.84 |
| Pathway minus reference | -1.85 | -1.87 | -3.71 | -6.16 to -1.31 |

: Soil-carbon change relative to the reference, Tg C. Contrasts preserve original ensemble-member identity before summarization. Positive values indicate more soil carbon relative to the reference trajectory. {#tbl-soc-contrasts}

Management retains an average of 1.55 Tg C more than the reference trajectory by December 2045. Changing the climate model produces little change in the statewide mean but different annual- and woody-crop responses. SSP585 reduces soil carbon by an additional 3.71 Tg C relative to the reference.

![County soil-carbon change relative to the reference scenario. The three panels share a signed color scale.](assets/carb-results/scenario-soc-contrasts.png){#fig-scenario-soc-contrasts .lightbox fig-alt="Three California county maps showing management, climate-model, and pathway soil-carbon contrasts against the reference scenario"}

## Annual N~2~O-N

![Annual N~2~O-N for the reference and management scenarios. Lines show ensemble means; ribbons show empirical member p05–p95.](assets/carb-results/scenario-n2o-annual.png){#fig-scenario-n2o-annual .lightbox fig-alt="Line chart of annual nitrous-oxide nitrogen for reference and management scenarios from 2024 to 2045"}

Scenario N~2~O-N is integrated over each calendar year and reported in kg N ha^-1^ yr^-1^.

![Management-minus-reference annual N~2~O-N. Differences preserve original ensemble-member identity.](assets/carb-results/scenario-n2o-contrast.png){#fig-scenario-n2o-contrast .lightbox fig-alt="Line chart of matched-member management-minus-reference annual nitrous-oxide nitrogen differences from 2024 to 2045"}

| Year | Reference | Management | Management minus reference |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2024 | 23.71 | 23.85 | 0.14 |
| 2030 | 22.13 | 22.47 | 0.34 |
| 2035 | 21.54 | 22.33 | 0.79 |
| 2040 | 15.06 | 15.54 | 0.48 |
| 2045 | 20.94 | 22.06 | 1.11 |

: Selected annual N~2~O-N means, kg N ha^-1^ yr^-1^. {#tbl-annual-n2o}

The management mean is higher than the reference in most years, although the matched-member range commonly crosses zero. Methane is not shown here; methane analysis will focus on crop fields with at least one rice season.
